title: Think-harder knob: a looped model trained with random depth
follows: R1.02b (learned halting), R1.07/R1.08 (scorecard on benchmark v3)
question: If a shared block is trained with a random number of iterations (1-8), does test-time depth become a real capability knob (FAST 1, NORMAL 2, DEEP 4, ULTRA 8), and does ULTRA beat a model trained at fixed depth 4?

predictions.PASS: OOD accuracy never drops as the knob rises, and ULTRA beats the fixed-depth model by >= 2 points OOD
predictions.K3: reported: random-depth training costs <= 2 points at depth 4 (dev)

prior_art: Recurrent depth 2502.05171, Universal Transformer 1807.03819, Looped Transformers 2409.15647
not_claimed: Mixture-of-Depths, recurrent-depth training and early exit are prior art; the question is whether they pay on this benchmark at this scale.
